abstract: Teratocarcinoma cells (F9) were induced to differentiate by retinoic acid and then labelled with [3H]-glucosamine and [35S]-sulphate. Proteoglycans were then isolated from the plasma membranes and the culture medium by mild, dissociative, non-shear-dependent techniques. The undifferentiated cells were devoid of hyaluronic acid and contained negligible quantities of heparan sulphate, dermatan sulphate and chondroitin sulphate. Upon differentiation, the cells synthesized large amounts of hyaluronic acid and there was a threefold increase in the amount of membrane-bound sulphated proteoglycans. The differentiated cells also synthesized a proteoglycan (PGM-2) which was shed completely into the medium. It consisted of a large protein core with covalently linked sugar chains which were sulphated and had an approximate molecular weight of 12000. These sugar chains consisted of glucosamine and galactose in a molar ratio of 1:1 and contained a small quantity of mannose. Upon differentiation of the cells the amount of this molecule increased by threefold. This molecule was distinct from other proteoglycans since it was resistant to degradation by heparanase, chondroitinases, hyaluronidase and neuraminidase, but could be degraded by keratanase. Structurally it was very similar to keratan sulphate, consisting of alternating residues of (-Gal-GlcNAc-) in chains of approximately 20 such disaccharide units.
abstract_ja: 奇形癌細胞（F9）をレチノイン酸で分化誘導し、[3H]-グルコサミンおよび[35S]-硫酸で標識した。プロテオグリカンは、穏やかで解離的かつ非せん断依存的な手法により、原形質膜および培養培地から単離した。未分化細胞ではヒアルロン酸を欠き、ヘパラン硫酸、デルマタン硫酸、コンドロイチン硫酸をわずかしか含まなかった。分化に伴い、細胞は大量のヒアルロン酸を合成し、膜結合型硫酸化プロテオグリカンは3倍に増加した。分化した細胞はまた、PGM-2と呼ばれるプロテオグリカンを合成し、これは完全に培地中へ放出された。PGM-2は、硫酸化され分子量約12000の糖鎖が共有結合した大型のタンパク質コアからなる。糖鎖はグルコサミンとガラクトースをモル比1:1で含み、少量のマンノースを含んでいた。分化に伴いこの分子の量は3倍に増加した。この分子はヘパラナーゼ、コンドロイチナーゼ、ヒアルロニダーゼ、ノイラミニダーゼに耐性であったが、ケラナーゼで分解された。構造はケラタン硫酸によく似ており、約20単位のジ糖（-Gal-GlcNAc-）が交互に連なる鎖であった。
